title: Multiplication modulo N has hidden structure
lede: Points 0 to N-1 sit on a circle. Each point i is joined to the point m times i, modulo N. Change m and N, or press Play to sweep m through fractions.
notice: With m = 2 the lines trace a cardioid, and with m = 3 a nephroid. In general the envelope has m-1 cusps.
The gold dots are the fixed points, where m times i equals i modulo N. For whole m there are exactly gcd(m-1, N) of them.
Between whole values of m the envelope blurs. The sharp curves belong to integer m.
hint: Drag the sliders, or press Play to sweep m.
